title: One turn whose tool results carry generated filler into the request body

turns.prompt: Using only the file-reading tool and never a shell command, read every generated filler file in the current directory in full, then quote the first and last row of each one verbatim.

notes: The filler is generated by the driver in the run's throwaway cwd rather than committed, and is chunked to what the client will read back in full: padding reaches the wire only as a tool result, so a file over the client's own read caps returns nothing at all.
